svg.title: A complete local annotation draft returns through the current cluster review
svg.desc: The cluster source and local QuPath draft share one image coordinate frame. The same protected contour P and image features appear in the before-and-after pair. Local editing revises R1, removes R2 and adds R3. Saving and closing QuPath returns the complete GeoJSON collection containing P, R1 and R3 with its review ticket. Python checks the current image and review. QuPath compares the returned objects with the current source by original ID, preserves P, replaces R1, removes R2 and adds R3. Native saving writes candidate.qpdata with the existing cells retained. The saved references reach pipeline review before the separate Freeze references and fit action. Shapes, abbreviated IDs and cell glyphs are schematic.
